data.one_liner: Adyen checkout library for Flutter to accept payments with cards and local methods.
data.what_it_does: The Adyen Flutter package provides building blocks to create a checkout experience using Drop-in or individual payment method Components. It allows shoppers to pay using cards, wallets, and local payment methods.
use_when: You need to integrate Adyen payments into a Flutter app.
You want to use native Adyen Drop-in or Components like Apple Pay and Google Pay.
avoid_when: You are using a different payment gateway like Stripe.
You only need in-app purchases through Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
strengths: Supports native Drop-in UI for iOS and Android.
Includes specific UI components for cards, BLIK, Google Pay, and Apple Pay.
weaknesses: Requires complex native configuration on both Android and iOS.
Strict dependency requirements on native Android and iOS SDK versions, Gradle, and Kotlin.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android 6.0+, compileSdk 36+, Kotlin 2.3.21+, FlutterFragmentActivity on Android, and a custom URL scheme and AppDelegate return URL handler on iOS.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are integrating Stripe payments instead of Adyen.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are selling digital goods via the official Apple App Store or Google Play Store billing systems.
